title: Angry Animals
content: In Dinotopia, dinosaurs and humans humans get along most of the time. But not always.If you drive a strutter through the Rainy Basin, don’t be surprised if you get attacked by a T. rex. (Image fromDinotopia: The World Beneath)The same is true with animals in our world, as the following photos attest.I don’t know the sources for these photos, so sorry, I can’t credit them.
